findings.evidence: PARTIAL_PASS — fix wired, empirical surface NOT proven. (a) Network sweep across all 18 round-2 states found exactly 1 × HTTP 429 on POST /api/admin/pos at ts=1778447368730 (state 14). (b) Round-2 fix commits 95c2fd799 + 654b96b96 wire a global axios interceptor in pos-app.js (lines ~103529-103601 of compiled bundle: TOAST_STATUSES Set([408,425,429,502,503,504]) + vue-toastification useToast + i18n message 'error.rate_limited' + 3s debounce) AND short-circuit PaymentComponent.handlePaymentError on status 429 to prevent double-toast. (c) Adversarial verification: state 14 DOM contains 5× empty Vue-Toastification__container (top-left/center/right/bottom-left/center/right) with zero rendered toast children at snapshot time. Substring search for 'rate_limited|patience|attendez|Trop de commandes|Too Many Attempts' returns 0 visible text matches in state 14 DOM. Root cause of evidence gap: the 429 fired on the /admin/pos catalog page, then the spec navigated `posPage.goto('/admin/pos-orders-tracker')` BEFORE the screenshot — destroying any toast that may have rendered. The empty toast container at snap is consistent with BOTH 'fix worked, toast dismissed by navigation' AND 'fix wired but never rendered'. Per adversarial integrity rule (REVIEWER_PROTOCOL — cannot declare PASS without empirical role=alert/.toast visibility on a 429-bearing snapshot), this is PARTIAL_PASS. Additional concern: vue-toastification emits no role="alert" and no aria-live (verified via node_modules/vue-toastification/dist/index.cjs — only role='img' on icons). Screen-reader users would still miss the rate-limit feedback even when the toast IS visible — protocol category 6 explicitly requires role=alert OR .toast OR .alert-* visible; the .Vue-Toastification__toast class arguably satisfies '.toast' but the aria gap is a P2 aria_keyboard sub-issue (see A-014).
findings.fix_hint: Round 3 must (a) snap the POS catalog page mid-burst (BEFORE navigating to tracker) so a 429 toast can be empirically captured; (b) add data-testid='toast-rate-limited' on the rendered toast for deterministic assertion; (c) consider adding role='alert' + aria-live='assertive' to the vue-toastification toast wrapper for screen-reader parity. Root cause could be (a) test instrumentation — the cluster-1 global axios interceptor in pos-app.js may transform a 429/4xx response into a resolved promise after toast (changing apparent status), OR (b) product silent-loss — pos commit endpoint returning 200+order-id without persisting under load (idempotency replay returning stale dummy?), OR (c) idempotency middleware short-circuiting and returning a cached 200 with no actual row. The audit cannot prove which — that ambiguity IS the finding. A P0 audit_integrity defect: the spec's 38/38 ok claim is structurally unsupported by independent fiscal evidence from the SAME run.
